entrypoints.gui_panel: PYTHONPATH=interface/src python3 -m ime_interface.app panel  (needs DISPLAY + IBUS_ADDRESS)

methods: reveal(index)  # True=scrolled, False=already fully visible, None=GTK has not allocated the row yet
options: layout（horizontal 缺省 / vertical 旧式单列）
max_visible（只作视口宽度预算，不裁剪候选）
panel.rows: self.rows[i] = {id, text, index, selected, widget, text_widget, note_widget, label_text, annotation}；text/id 始终是引擎原值，省略号只影响显示
panel.row_geometry_i: {id, text, index, x, y, w, h, text_w, text_needed, ellipsized, selected, in_view}（in_view = 是否完整落在横向视口可见区域；不额外暴露显示文本，避免 D-Bus 泄漏输入内容）
panel.layout_contract: 默认 horizontal：同一页候选同一行、x 依次增加；宽度上限 = 屏幕宽 - 2*edge_margin；超宽只省略文字（最少 2 字），再超宽则用 Gtk.ScrolledWindow 单行横向视口 + 可见滚动条；render 始终放 candidates[page_start:page_start+page_size] 整页，max_visible 只决定视口宽度预算（metrics().viewport_cap），逻辑页/候选编号/数字映射/完整 ID 不变（metrics().dropped_for_width 恒为 []）
panel.reveal_contract: 高亮自动滚动只在 GTK 完成真实 size-allocate 之后执行：新行分配前只有 1px 占位，reveal() 返回 None 且不移动视口；rows_box/scroller/每一行的 size-allocate 会再排一次核对（render serial + 视口指纹去重，无固定延时）。用户自己拖动横向滚动条不会被拽回；视口宽度、page_size 或 upper 改变时才会重新核对。
panel.short_page_contract: 每次 _fit_to_screen 先撤销 rows_box/scroller 的旧 size_request 再测自然宽度，短页的 content_natural_width 与 scroll.upper 按新内容收缩，布局稳定后 _clamp_scroll() 把 value 收敛到 upper-page_size，滚到末端不会整页空白；回到整页时范围恢复，页首高亮重新可见。
panel.metrics: {layout, font_scale, screen, width_limit, content_width, content_natural_width, max_visible, viewport_cap, page_start, page_size, visible, dropped_for_width(恒 []), ids, in_view, scroll:{value, page_size, upper, scrollable, scrollbar_visible}}

platform: CandidatePanel is horizontal by default (panel.layout, default horizontal); ProductPanel inherits it, so product assertions on same-row/increasing-x need no extra code. Use metrics() for width_limit/content_width/ids/in_view/scroll; dropped_for_width is kept for compatibility and is always []. panel.max_visible is only a viewport width budget (metrics()['viewport_cap']): every page_size candidate is still rendered, numbered and selectable; only the visible window is narrower and scrolls horizontally.

row_geometry() entries carry id/text/index/x/y/w/h/text_w/text_needed/ellipsized/selected/in_view; text is the full engine candidate, 'ellipsized' only describes display, 'in_view' is true when the cell is fully inside the horizontal viewport (scroll with panel.scroll_by/reveal or check panel.metrics()['scroll']).
Narrow width never removes candidates: the page keeps all of them in a single-row scroller, the hint line no longer claims 'the rest need Page Down'.
Read interface settings via ime_interface.config.load() and pass platform_patch()['page_size'] into Controller(page_size=…).
Optional: call ime_interface.punctuation.Punctuation.map_char() in the key path for Chinese punctuation.
Optional: use ime_interface.keymap.resolve() for shortcut actions; defaults already match Controller.key().

The scroller now keeps the row's natural width (rows_box minimum width) and does not propagate it to the popup, so the product panel can be narrower than the candidate row and still shows a horizontal scrollbar; product-side cursor placement should use panel.geometry() as before.

0.1.5 layout fix: auto-reveal now happens only after GTK size-allocate; reveal() returns None while the new row still has its 1px pre-layout placeholder. Do not treat None as 'in view' and do not add fixed sleeps. The panel re-checks on rows_box/scroller/row allocation and clamps the scroll range (short pages: content_natural_width and scroll.upper shrink). Manually scrolling the viewport is not snapped back unless the viewport size or scroll range changes. Rebuild/re-run the product narrow checks against this version.

ProductPanel.render calls _fit_to_screen() a second time after super().render() (product hint text). That is still supported: a changed width triggers a new allocation, and the render serial keeps one reveal owed until a real allocation is measured.
